name: resume-gen
description: Nick Florin's resume: Astro source in src/, built to a multi-page HTML site, a single self-contained HTML file, and a print-ready PDF.

scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run artifact && npm run pdf

//overrides: @tailwindcss/vite resolves its own copy of Vite, which lands a second major version in the tree alongside Astro's. The plugin then hands a config object to a Vite it was not loaded by and the build fails on a binding mismatch. Pin one Vite for everyone.
